study_status: internal predeclared scenario specification; not externally registered or peer reviewed
claim_boundary: 2020 observed prices with documented 2022 annual-average CHP reference and hypothetical heat and operating conditions; conditional perfect-foresight LP; not observed dispatch, time-series validation, or probabilistic forecast.
price_window_selection_rule: Local civil day 1 of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct 2020, independently of result. July 1 fails hourly completeness QA and is excluded; no imputation or replacement day. Three complete days used. NOT an annual or representative sample.

rejected_window.reason: A gap in provider hourly records: the extracted 24 records span a 25-hour UTC interval (2020-06-30 22:00 to 2020-07-01 22:00); cannot treat as complete 24-hour local day. Excluded before any optimizer result inspection.

rating_variants.provenance: SLU thesis reports nameplate electric rating 499 kW
HYPOTHETICAL reduced installed rating =1.05 × mean electric output at selected efficiency, not the Lövsta nameplate

gas_supply_basis: 2022 Lövsta annual-average 3002.6 MWh_e with eta_e=0.4 implies gas input 0.85690639 MW_LHV; gas input unchanged when varying efficiency; NOT a measured annual gas-LHV flow.
thermal_efficiency_basis: Fixed hypothetical thermal efficiency fitted to 2022 annual heat/electric ratio at 40% electric efficiency, not measured heat conversion.

resilience_definition.metric: MWh electric/heat critical demand served during declared interruption; not regional resilience, plant capability or black-start validation.

excluded_from_scope: Enacted Swedish policy premiums or incentives
Plant actual islanding or export meter data
